pyAutomationPage.pyUsage:
This automation returns a list of email message ids of the emails sent. If sendDiscretely is set to false, the list will contain only one email message id.

If sendDiscretely is set to true, the number of message ids will be equal to the number of recipients in the 'To' list.

Set PersistMinimalEmail is to true to save a minimal copy of email messages in Pega database to make optimum utilization of storage space.

Email message id(s) can be later used in pxGetEmailStatus automation to get the status of the email(s) sent.

pyAutomationPage.pyDescription:
Sends a previously created email message using the specified email account. Email can be sent in foreground (synchronous operation) or can be queued for sending later (asynchronous operation). 

A separate email will be sent to each recipient in the 'To' list if sendDiscretely is set to true.
